# Dr. Saumika Singh — Oculoplasty, Orbit & Ocular Oncology Surgeon, Lucknow, India

> Dr. Saumika Singh is a fellowship-trained oculoplasty, orbit and ocular oncology
> surgeon in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. She consults primarily at Alyantra Medicity
> Superspeciality Hospital, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow, and visits other centres as required.
> She holds MBBS, MS (Ophthalmology) and FICO (Fellow of the International Council of
> Ophthalmology, UK) and is registered with the Uttar Pradesh Medical Council
> (Reg. No. 137106). This bilingual website (English + Hindi, Hindi under /hi/) covers
> her clinical services, peer-reviewed publications and consented surgical case studies.

## Practice details

- Hospital: Alyantra Medicity Superspeciality Hospital, Plot No. TC-49, V-XIII, Vibhuti Khand, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow 226010, Uttar Pradesh, India
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 10:00–18:00, by appointment
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 74600 88838
- Email: contact@drsaumika.in
- Languages: English, Hindi

## About

- [Surgeon profile — Dr. Saumika Singh](https://drsaumika.in/about): Qualifications (MBBS; MS Ophthalmology; FICO, International Council of Ophthalmology, UK), oculoplasty and ocular oncology fellowship training, clinical experience, publications and professional memberships.

## Clinical services

- [Eyelid disorders & eyelid surgery](https://drsaumika.in/services/eyelid-disorders-eyelid-surgery): Ptosis (drooping eyelid), entropion, ectropion, eyelid lumps and tumours, chalazion, xanthelasma, blepharoplasty and eyelid reconstruction.
- [Watering eyes & tear drainage disorders (DCR)](https://drsaumika.in/services/watering-eyes-tear-drainage-disorders/dcr): Epiphora (watering eye), blocked tear duct, dacryocystitis, external DCR (dacryocystorhinostomy), canalicular repair, and probing/syringing for babies with blocked tear ducts.
- [Orbital disorders & orbital surgery](https://drsaumika.in/services/orbital-disorders-orbital-surgery): Thyroid eye disease, orbital tumours and orbital fractures.
- [Eye tumours & ocular oncology](https://drsaumika.in/services/eye-tumours-ocular-oncology): Eyelid, conjunctival and intraocular tumours, including eyelid cancers such as sebaceous gland carcinoma.
- [Socket reconstruction & artificial eye rehabilitation](https://drsaumika.in/services/socket-reconstruction-artificial-eye-rehabilitation): Surgery after loss of an eye, contracted socket reconstruction and custom artificial eye (ocular prosthesis) rehabilitation.
- [Eye trauma & eyelid/orbital reconstruction](https://drsaumika.in/services/eye-trauma-eyelid-orbital-reconstruction): Eyelid lacerations, canalicular injuries and orbital fractures.
- [Botox, cosmetic eyelid surgery & periocular aesthetics](https://drsaumika.in/services/botox-eyelid-cosmetic-surgery-periocular-aesthetics): Medical and cosmetic Botox around the eyes, and upper and lower blepharoplasty.
- [Why choose an oculoplasty & ocular oncology specialist](https://drsaumika.in/services/why-choose-an-oculoplasty-ocular-oncology-specialist): What an oculoplastic surgeon is and when to see one.
